description.zh: 指定的获取IP的Header值，当选择默认Header时，该值为空；选择自定义Header时，该值为用户输入的值。传多个值时需要使用逗号分隔，最多5个。
description.en: The header used to obtain the client IP address. If you use the default header, leave this parameter empty. If you use a custom header, set this parameter to the header name. You can specify up to five header names. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh:
防护域名状态，取值：on、off、和空值。

- 接入域名时为**on**，此时ClientIpTag的值生效（选默认时为空；选自定义Header时为对应的值）。
- 删除域名时为**off**，此时ClientIpTag不生效。
- 只修改ClientIpTag时，DefenseStatus为空。
description.en:
The protection status. Valid values: \`on\`, \`off\`, or empty.

- **on**: Enables protection for the domain names. The \`ClientIpTag\` parameter takes effect. If you use the default header, \`ClientIpTag\` is empty. If you use a custom header, \`ClientIpTag\` is set to the specified value.

- **off**: Disables protection for the domain names. The \`ClientIpTag\` parameter does not take effect.

- empty: Leave this parameter empty if you only want to modify the \`ClientIpTag\` parameter.

description.zh: 需修改防护状态域名，最多输入50个，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The domain names for which you want to change the protection status. You can specify up to 50 domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

title.zh: 批量设置域名防护状态

descriptions.zh:
> 
> - 单用户调用频率：20次/秒。
> - 请求方式：支持POST请求。
descriptions.en:
> - The maximum call frequency for a single user is 20 calls per second.
>
> - This operation supports POST requests.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn batch-set-dcdn-waf-domain-configs --domain-names example.com,example2.com --defense-status on --client-ip-tag X-Forwarded-For --region cn-hangzhou
